note:
FILED BEFORE IT IS SPENT, WHICH IS THE POINT OF THIS RECORD (T-0617, 2026-09-04).

WHAT IT SHOWS. A one-storey LOG building at the right, gable roof, a door and two windows on the near face, saddle-notched corners; a woman in a white apron standing in the doorway; girls in bonnets and aprons streaming along the bank toward it. To the left, a shore: one canoe afloat with paddlers, two more drawn up with figures around them. In the middle distance a white lighthouse tower on a low point, and beyond it a scatter of small gabled buildings on a flat prairie horizon.

THE CAPTION AND THE PICTURE DISAGREE, AND THAT IS THE USEFUL PART. Clark and Lake is inland, and the 1834 destination of Chappell's school on that corner was the FRAME First Presbyterian Church — not a log building, and not on a shore. Two readings are open and this record asserts neither:
  (a) It is Chappell's FIRST school of September 1833, the "small log house formerly used as a store" that the Beaubien material identifies as Mark Beaubien's own original cabin beside the Sauganash at Lake and Market. That corner stands on the south branch's bank, which is a shore with canoes on it. On this reading the picture is a FIFTH view of the Sauganash's log annex, and the most informative one, because it shows the building nearly square-on.
  (b) It is some other log schoolhouse, in which case it belongs to whatever record it does depict and not to the Sauganash at all.

HOW IT GETS SETTLED, AND IT IS A MEASUREMENT RATHER THAN AN IMPRESSION. The lighthouse is the control: it fixes the view direction toward the river mouth and puts the scene at or after the harbour light's construction, and the tree already holds chicago_harbor_lighthouse_1838.jpg to compare the tower against. The bank's bearing, the tower's position and the building's orientation read together say which corner of the town this can be standing on. That work is its own ticket, T-0649.

WHAT MAY NOT BE DONE WITH IT MEANWHILE. It is an undated retrospective drawing by an unnamed hand until someone establishes otherwise. It may not move an attributed plate — Braunhold, Petford, Trowbridge — on any axis where the two disagree. Where it agrees with them it corroborates; where it is alone it is a single weak view, graded the way T-0092 graded the shutter leaves.
